# Routes have 2–400 stops

`BT-5` · Owner decision

Route size: 2–400 companies globally, no per-city cap. The 150-per-city rule is leftover unless ops has a hard reason

Defined in [[brain/audits/03-parity|Audit 3 – mobile vs web]].
